candidate.definition_en: A group of houses and associated buildings, larger than a hamlet and smaller than a town, situated in a rural area.
candidate.explanation_ar: قرية، مكان صغير الناس بتعيش فيه في الريف، أصغر من المدينة.

senses.definition_en: A group of houses and associated buildings, larger than a hamlet and smaller than a town, situated in a rural area.
senses.explanation_ar: قرية، تجمع سكني صغير في الريف أصغر من المدينة.
examples: I live in a small village.
The village is near the mountains.
Everyone in the village knows each other.
